diff_one.provenance_note: The required binary is not provenance-clean for implementation commit 34cc76f1. The adjacent source checkout head differs from 34cc in crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs and removes the exact note-order, package-ownership, qualified-name, line0/minlen, and solved-contact changes under review. Fresh strict failures from the required executable were therefore recorded but not attributed to 34cc without corroborating source evidence.

java: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal creates attached notes as real NOTE leaves in the current namespace and gives LEFT/RIGHT links length 1 and TOP/BOTTOM links length 2.

GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage calls printGroups before getUnpackagedEntities; printGroup emits direct leaves before child groups, so package-first traversal rather than one global constructor order controls node creation.

Bibliotekon stores nodes in a LinkedHashMap and partitions length-one links into lines0; SvekResult.drawU paints allNodes in insertion order and leaves EntityImageNote to consume the solved edge path.

EntityImageNote.drawU reverses the solved path when necessary so the note-side contact is the start point, then getOpaleStrategy chooses the nearest note side by orthogonal distance with left, right, up, down tie priority.
rust: At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:2262-2274 adds LEFT/RIGHT attached notes as PlantUML line0 edges plus same-rank edges with minlen zero, matching the Java length-one link semantics under audit.

At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:2341-2368 adds note layout nodes to package clusters through the unified svek_node_emission_order stream, carrying package ownership into the actual layout solve instead of batching entities and empty leaves by kind.
At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:4276-4284 qualifies both attached GMN names and floating aliases with the owner package path, while root-owned notes remain unqualified.

At 34cc76f1, crates/rustuml-render/src/class.rs:12735-12749 and 13196-13240 implement solved-contact note-side selection: note-side contact is chosen from the routed edge direction and then converted through attached_note_render_position instead of trusting the declaration syntax.

The later /tmp/rustuml-checker-1482 source checkout head c0133a1 removes those exact 34cc blocks: it deletes note membership from the unified cluster pass, deletes note_qualified_name and attached_note_render_position, and stops registering LEFT/RIGHT notes as line0/minlen-zero edges. The fresh strict failures produced by the required executable align with that later state, not with 34cc source.

findings.evidence: The 34cc source carries note owner packages into cluster membership, emits notes through the unified direct-leaf traversal, qualifies attached/floating notes with owner paths, registers LEFT/RIGHT attached notes as line0 plus minlen-zero edges, and chooses the callout side from the solved contact rather than the declaration syntax.

findings.summary: The required strict-check executable is not reliable evidence against 34cc76f1 because its adjacent source checkout is a later state that deletes the exact 34cc fixes under audit.
findings.evidence: The /tmp/rustuml-checker-1482 checkout head is c0133a1 with class.rs blob 49ecb32c, while 34cc76f1 has blob 89ed99f2. The c0133a1 diff removes note-qualified names, note package-cluster membership, note participation in svek_node_emission_order, left/right line0/minlen-zero handling, and solved-contact side selection. The fresh strict failures are therefore recorded but not attributed to 34cc.
